messages:
Marisol (Sales): quick handoff for Meriwell — signed for Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool). Go-live target May 15. High level:
- 6 GPU nodes reserved, throughput target 150 reqs/sec, typical seq len ~512
- Must support SCIM SSO + customer-managed KMS
- They hit degraded p50/p95 latency during our stress run last week (see logs link)
- Renewal touchpoint in 11 months; risk if we miss initial SLA

Contract & notes: https://redwood.internal/sales/meriwell-opp (sales doc)
Please take ownership of onboarding and coordinate perf tuning with eng. Marisol -> primary sales contact.

Priya (CS): thanks Marisol — taking point. Quick questions so we can scope runbook:
1) Which model variant are they planning to run (prod candidate)?
2) Do they need private control plane (VPC) now or later?
3) Can you grant CS test access to their SSO test tenant?

I'll schedule a kickoff with Meriwell for next Tue and draft an enablement checklist.

Marisol (Sales): answers — model: open-llm-v2-7B-quantized (recommended), private control plane = yes (VPC), test tenant created: sso-test@meriwell-demo (pw shared in 1:1). Also they want HSM/KMS integration in week 1. Latency spikes happened during a 2k concurrent session synthetic run — attached flamegraph and error snippets.

Devon (Support): noted. I'll open a support ticket and provision a perf-triage label. Need: the exact inference config (batch size, context window, kv cache policy) and a sample workload (replay logs). Can @Avery share the typical config you suggest for this model?

Avery (SE): suggested starter config for 7B quantized:
```
- batch_size: 8
- max_seq: 1024
- kv_cache_eviction: sticky
- async_prefetch: true
- quant_profile: q4_0
```
Also recommend enabling prefix caching for the first 512 tokens and testing with smaller concurrency to find the knee before ramping. I'll join the kickoff for perf tuning.

OpsBot: created ticket CS-4821 (component: perf-triage) and assigned to Devon + eng-runtime oncall.

Priya (CS): action items I'm tracking: 
- CS kickoff with Meriwell (owner: Priya) — scheduled Tue 10:00 PT
- Support ticket CS-4821 (owner: Devon) — scope: collect logs, reproduce latency, correlate to kernel selection
- SE perf session (owner: Avery) — run targeted bench with config above by Wed EOD
- Eng runtime follow-up (owner: eng-runtime) — ETA initial findings by next Fri
- KMS/SSO setup (owner: Marisol -> infra contact) — target in onboarding week 1

Please confirm owners/comments. I'll post the kickoff notes and attach the replay artifacts afterwards.

Marisol (Sales): confirmed on SSO/KMS owner and will introduce infra contact on the kickoff. Renewal risk flagged but contingent on SLA met post-onboarding. :thumbsup:

Devon (Support): I'll start by pulling the stress-run logs and create a repro plan. If eng runtime needs a kernel tweak, I'll escalate via CS-4821.

Priya (CS): perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update the thread after the kickoff and link the runbook (cc @Avery for perf checklist).
